meta.name: controleur-fiscal
meta.description:
Inspecteur des finances publiques IA. Simule un contrôle fiscal DGFIP complet sur les comptes d'une
entreprise française (SASU, EURL, SAS, SARL). Analyse le FEC, la liasse fiscale, les charges déduites,
le compte courant d'associé, la TVA, l'IS selon 8 axes de vérification. Identifie les chefs de
redressement potentiels avec montants, base légale et niveaux de risque.

Triggers: contrôle fiscal, redressement, vérification comptabilité, DGFIP, FEC, déductibilité, audit fiscal, tax audit

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟法国税务稽查，分析企业财务风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是法国企业主或会计师，想提前排查税务稽查风险。
copy.tagline_en: Simulate French tax audit and analyze financial risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a French business owner or accountant wanting to pre-check tax audit risks.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会扮演法国公共财政总局(DGFIP)的税务稽查员,模拟对一家法国公司的完整税务稽查。它会按 8 个轴心检查 FEC、税表、可扣除费用、往来账户、TVA、IS 等,并对每个可疑项给出追缴金额、法律依据和风险等级。
howto.when: 当你提到「contrôle fiscal」「redressement」「FEC」等触发词,或要求模拟税务稽查、核对账目时触发。启动前若缺少公司身份、会计年度、文件等信息,它会先向你询问。

say.text: 请对我的 SASU 公司做一次模拟税务稽查。
say.note: 它会先索要公司信息和年度账目。

say.text: 检查这份 FEC 文件,找出可能的调整项。
say.note: 它会按 8 个轴心检查并输出风险等级。

say.text: 帮我分析这些费用是否可扣除。
say.note: 它会核查四项可扣除条件并给法律依据。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an AI tax inspector simulating a full DGFIP audit on a French company. It reviews FEC, tax returns, expenses, shareholder current account, VAT and IS across 8 axes, and outputs potential adjustments with amounts, legal basis and risk levels.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "contrôle fiscal", "redressement", "FEC" or when asked to simulate a tax audit. Before starting, it asks for company identity, fiscal year and documents if missing.

say_en.text: Run a simulated tax audit on my SASU company.
say_en.note: It will first request company info and fiscal year.

say_en.text: Check this FEC file and identify possible adjustments.
say_en.note: It reviews 8 axes and outputs risk levels.

say_en.text: Help me analyze whether these expenses are deductible.
say_en.note: It verifies the four deductibility conditions.
